values.goal: Make the supported local Observatory load over browser-trusted HTTPS without warning bypasses.
values.required_outcome: One documented and reproducible local trust flow makes Chrome, Observatory startup, configured URLs, health checks, and Runtime feed access agree on trusted HTTPS.
declared_scope: Runtime and Observatory HTTPS configuration and docs
authority_boundary: Issue 5800 owns local Observatory certificate trust and HTTPS consistency
WP-03 owns broader Runtime launch and resilience
No AWS certificate or hosted production TLS work is authorized
operator_constraints: Do not bypass browser or TLS verification
Use one stable supported trust model
Never edit tracked work on main
